image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large crocodile (likely a Nile crocodile) resting on a rocky surface. The mouth is slightly open, revealing teeth and the interior of the jaw. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, armored scales (scutes) along the back and smoother scales on the lower jaw. The lighting highlights the yellowish-green coloration of the snout and the darker, textured armor on the body.
